dialogues.speaker: Mirsky
dialogues.text: That's it. I trust my instincts.

dialogues.speaker: Mirsky
dialogues.text: ...What could Vernadska have done wrong that the Moonchanter would punish her personally?

dialogues.speaker: Mirsky
dialogues.text: How could anyone do anything wrong in a place this empty? I need to go into town to buy materials just to build a basic water pump.

dialogues.speaker: Mirsky
dialogues.text: *sigh* But if she must be punished, then she must be punished. And it has to be said, Miss Lauma is far kinder than my old boss...
